portfolioCall: Lead with Signal as a measured workflow pilot. Keep Forge as the delivery proof behind that pilot, not a separate broad launch.

products.name: Signal Briefing
products.audience: Small research and operations teams that repeatedly turn noisy source feeds into a daily decision.
products.hook: A ranked shortlist with visible rejection reasons instead of another undifferentiated feed.
products.route: Recruit five workflow-fit design partners, run their real source windows through Signal, and review the shortlist with them before discussing a paid pilot.
products.advanceWhen: At least three teams use the shortlist in a real decision twice in one week and ask to repeat the workflow.
evidence: Evidence gap: no external design-partner sessions recorded yet.
risks: Source configuration may require high-touch onboarding

products.name: Forge Production Kit
products.audience: Teams that need a repeatable, provenance-backed path from an approved brief to a publishable artefact.
products.hook: Every output ships with deterministic quality gates and a provenance record.
products.route: Use Forge inside the Signal pilot and document whether its gates reduce review time; do not market it as a standalone product yet.
products.advanceWhen: Two pilot teams ship accepted artefacts with less review rework and can explain which gate created the value.
evidence: Evidence gap: no comparative review-time dataset.
risks: Standalone buyer and route are unproven
